description: Source code for random number generation utilities used in qhull, including functions for command-line argument processing, pseudo-random number generation, and matrix creation.

methods.name: qh_argv_to_command
methods.description: Builds a command string from argc/argv array, handling quoting and filename stripping.

methods.name: qh_argv_to_command_size
methods.description: Calculates the buffer size needed for qh_argv_to_command.

methods.name: qh_rand
methods.description: Generates a pseudo-random number between 1 and 2^31 - 2 using Park & Miller's generator.

methods.name: qh_srand
methods.description: Seeds the random number generator with a given seed.

methods.name: qh_randomfactor
methods.description: Returns a scaled and offset random factor based on qh_RANDOMint.

methods.name: qh_randommatrix
methods.description: Generates a random matrix with values in [-1, 1].

methods.name: qh_strtod
methods.description: Internal version of strtod() that does not skip trailing spaces.

methods.name: qh_strtol
methods.description: Internal version of strtol() that does not skip trailing spaces.
